name: Normal Furry
summary: The Normal Furry is a common enemy that attacks at close range.
role: Kill Normal Furries before they enter the capture area. A group of these enemies can stop a capture.
fun_facts: Normal Furries are the reference point for the larger variants: faster, tankier, ranged, or explosive enemies are built around this baseline pressure.

name: Pimple Furry
summary: The Pimple Furry is a slow enemy that explodes after it dies.
role: Kill this enemy away from other players. Move away from the body after the enemy dies.
fun_facts: Pimple Furries use the shorter explosive respawn delay shared by the other detonation-style enemies.

name: Watcher Furry
summary: The Watcher Furry is a fast enemy that attacks at close range.
role: Kill Watcher Furries first when they get close to the team.
fun_facts: Watcher Furries are faster than Normal Furries and have twice the health.

name: Bloater Furry
summary: The Bloater Furry is a slow enemy with high health. It explodes after it dies.
role: Kill this enemy away from the team and the capture area. Move away before it explodes.
fun_facts: Bloaters are the slowest regular Furry variant.

name: Leader Furry
summary: The Leader Furry is a strong enemy with high health.
role: Attack the Leader Furry with the team. Watch for other enemies while you attack it.
fun_facts: A Leader has thirty-five times the health of a Normal Furry.

name: Robot Furry
summary: The Robot Furry is a strong enemy that attacks quickly at close range.
role: Keep your distance and kill this enemy before it reaches the team.
fun_facts: Robot Furries have the fastest melee attack cooldown among the regular variants.

name: Spitter Furry
summary: The Spitter Furry attacks players from a long distance.
role: Move behind cover or kill the Spitter Furry first.
fun_facts: Spitter Furries try to stay at a long distance from the target.

name: Furry Helper
summary: Furry Helpers are small enemies in the boss area. They explode after they die.
role: Kill Furry Helpers before they surround the team. Move away from them after they die.
fun_facts: Helpers can approach the boss arena from several routes, so the fight rarely stays quiet for long.

name: Furry Boss
summary: The Furry Boss is the final enemy in Traditional mode. The boss becomes available after the team captures all six enemy territories.
role: Attack the boss with the team. Attack the core when it restores health to the boss.

stats.defeated_badge: Awarded to all players on boss defeat

fun_facts: The boss reward can roll higher multipliers for the top contributor.
The game calculates boss health and difficulty from the number of active fighters.
